units.title: Diagnostic A: Python, SQL, data cleaning
units.objective: Produce time-boxed, unassisted evidence of current skill in Python refactoring/debugging, SQL joins and aggregation, and pandas data cleaning.
units.deliverable: Completed labs for a1/a2/a3 plus the Session A part of diagnostic/SUBMISSION.md.

units.title: Diagnostic B: baselines, leakage, testing/API, explaining a decision
units.objective: Produce time-boxed, unassisted evidence in baseline modelling on an unfamiliar business table, leakage detection, test writing, API concepts and written justification.
units.deliverable: Completed labs for b1/b2/b3, the written b4 answer, and the finished diagnostic/SUBMISSION.md.

units.title: From script to installable package: project structure and environments
units.objective: Turn a notebook-export script into a src-layout package with pyproject.toml, an isolated environment, an editable install and a console entry point, proving behaviour is preserved.
units.deliverable: Installable `pumpwatch` package + refactoring log with before/after metrics.

units.title: Configuration, logging and reproducible runs
units.objective: Make a training run reproducible and inspectable: typed validated config with overrides, logging configured once, explicit seeds, and a run directory with config snapshot, metrics and provenance.
units.deliverable: `pumpwatch` v0.2 producing self-describing run directories; two identical runs shown to match.

units.title: Testing ML code with pytest: what a unit test can and cannot tell you
units.objective: Write a pytest suite that catches realistic defects in signal-feature and splitting code, and separate deterministic unit tests from statistical performance checks.
units.deliverable: A test suite that kills the seeded bugs (mutation-graded) and a one-paragraph note on what it does not establish.

units.title: Independent refactor: a real exploratory notebook becomes the project skeleton
units.objective: Without step-by-step guidance, refactor an exploratory notebook on the project dataset into the `flowguard` package skeleton using small reviewed Git commits (branch, commit hygiene, .gitignore, lint).
units.deliverable: Project repository skeleton: package, config, tests, README stub, clean commit history.

units.title: Review and catch-up (light)
units.objective: Retrieve, do not re-read: answer the week's retrieval questions from memory, redo one failed check or challenge unassisted, complete the mixed interview set, update progress flags.
units.deliverable: Week 1 retrieval sheet answered; interview set 1 (Python + project structure).

units.title: SQL I: grain, joins, aggregation and NULL semantics
units.objective: Write correct multi-table queries by reasoning about table grain first; recognise fan-out, NULL and anti-join traps.
units.deliverable: Solved query set with a stated grain for every result; fan-out bug report on a broken query.

units.title: SQL II: CTEs, window functions and time-series queries
units.objective: Use window functions for ranking, running statistics, gaps-and-islands and as-of joins on event and sensor tables; reproduce each result in pandas.
units.deliverable: Query set + pandas equivalence tests; a point-in-time-correct feature query.

units.title: pandas ingestion, schemas and data-quality checks (project data arrives)
units.objective: Ingest the project dataset through a documented, re-runnable step with explicit schema and quality checks expressed as code that fails loudly.
units.deliverable: `flowguard ingest` command, data dictionary, data-quality report, provenance record (source, licence, hashes).

units.title: Problem framing and versioned split definitions
units.objective: Translate the stakeholder problem into an ML task: unit of prediction, label definition (point vs event), costs of errors, constraints; freeze splits by experiment and time in a versioned manifest.
units.deliverable: Problem statement, label definition, `splits/v1.json` manifest with a leakage-safety test.

units.title: Reproducible feature generation without look-ahead
units.objective: Build causal rolling-window features and train-only statistics as a deterministic, cached, tested pipeline step.
units.deliverable: Feature pipeline with no-look-ahead tests and content-addressed outputs.

units.title: Strong simple baselines and metrics that match the decision
units.objective: Establish trivial and classical baselines and choose metrics from the decision (imbalance, PR vs ROC, thresholds, calibration basics) on the project data and on an unfamiliar business table.
units.deliverable: Baseline table for the project (trivial, threshold, linear); transfer exercise part 1 baseline.

units.title: Review and catch-up (light)
units.objective: Retrieve, do not re-read: answer the week's retrieval questions from memory, redo one failed check or challenge unassisted, complete the mixed interview set, update progress flags.
units.deliverable: Week 2 retrieval sheet; interview set 2 (SQL + pandas, timed).

units.title: Leakage: a taxonomy and prevention by construction
units.objective: Classify and remove target, preprocessing, temporal, group and selection leakage; use pipelines so the correct thing is the default.
units.deliverable: Leak hunt report on a seeded dataset with corrected estimates and the mechanism of each leak.

units.title: Group-aware and temporal validation
units.objective: Design validation that matches deployment: grouped, temporal, and combined (experiment x time) schemes with purging/embargo where windows overlap.
units.deliverable: Validation design memo + implementation for the project; comparison against a naive random split.

units.title: Hyperparameter and threshold selection without fooling yourself
units.objective: Select hyperparameters and decision thresholds using only training/validation data; quantify selection optimism with nested validation.
units.deliverable: Tuned baseline with a nested estimate and a frozen-threshold test evaluation.

units.title: Point-level versus event-level evaluation for detection
units.objective: Implement and interpret point-wise metrics, event matching, detection delay and false alarms per hour; explain when each misleads.
units.deliverable: Tested `flowguard.evaluation` module; point vs event results table with interpretation.
units.prerequisites: w3d2 (your HFO event-evaluation experience transfers directly).

units.title: Uncertainty: cluster bootstrap, paired comparisons, small-n honesty
units.objective: Attach defensible intervals to metrics when the independent unit is the experiment, not the sample; compare models with paired resampling.
units.deliverable: Confidence intervals and a paired comparison for the baselines, with a stated unit of resampling.

units.title: Error analysis and timed transfer exercise
units.objective: Turn errors into a ranked failure taxonomy with slices; then run a complete leak-free evaluation on the unfamiliar business table, unassisted, in 90 minutes.
units.deliverable: Project error-analysis note; transfer exercise part 2 submission.

units.title: Review and catch-up (light)
units.objective: Retrieve, do not re-read: answer the week's retrieval questions from memory, redo one failed check or challenge unassisted, complete the mixed interview set, update progress flags.
units.deliverable: Week 3 retrieval sheet; interview set 3 (validation, leakage, ML fundamentals, spoken answers).

units.title: Time-series fundamentals and forecast-residual detectors
units.objective: Reason about autocorrelation, non-stationarity and windowing; build naive, seasonal-naive and autoregressive forecasters and use their residuals as anomaly scores.
units.deliverable: Residual-based detector evaluated with the Week 3 protocol.

units.title: Classical detectors: PCA/T2-Q, isolation forest, boosted trees on window features
units.objective: Fit methods to the label structure (semi-supervised vs supervised framing) and compare them under one protocol and compute budget.
units.deliverable: Comparison table with intervals; note on which framing the labels support.

units.title: A neural comparison, where it is justified
units.objective: Train a small 1D-CNN or LSTM autoencoder (PyTorch, CPU) with a fair tuning budget and multiple seeds; report seed variance.
units.deliverable: Neural result with seed variance in the comparison table; GPU optional.

units.title: Experiment tracking and reproducibility at the experiment level
units.objective: Manage many runs: sweep configs, registry of runs, aggregate results table, reproduce any row from its run id.
units.deliverable: `flowguard sweep` + results table generated from run directories (MLflow as an optional extension).

units.title: Choosing complexity on evidence
units.objective: Decide between candidates using effect size versus uncertainty, error costs, latency, size and maintenance burden.
units.deliverable: One-page decision memo choosing the model to ship.

units.title: Project milestone 1: evaluation report
units.objective: Assemble the model comparison and error analysis into a reproducible report generated by commands.
units.deliverable: `make evaluate` regenerates the comparison report; submit for review.

units.title: Review and catch-up (light)
units.objective: Retrieve, do not re-read: answer the week's retrieval questions from memory, redo one failed check or challenge unassisted, complete the mixed interview set, update progress flags.
units.deliverable: Week 4 retrieval sheet; interview set 4 (explain your evaluation in 5 minutes, recorded).

units.title: Research experimentation versus production inference
units.objective: Package preprocessing and model as one inference object used identically in training evaluation and serving; build a batch inference command.
units.deliverable: `flowguard predict-batch` with a training/serving parity test.

units.title: Model artifacts, metadata and versioning
units.objective: Serialise models with the metadata needed to trust and reload them (schema, feature list, versions, data and code hashes); understand pickle risks and alternatives.
units.deliverable: Versioned artifact bundle + load-time compatibility checks + model card draft.

units.title: Online inference on streams: state, warm-up and parity
units.objective: Implement stateful windowed scoring for one-sample-at-a-time input and prove parity with batch scoring.
units.deliverable: Streaming scorer with batch/online parity tests and documented warm-up behaviour.

units.title: FastAPI I: endpoints, schemas and input validation
units.objective: Expose predictions through a typed HTTP API: request/response models, validation errors versus server errors, health and readiness endpoints.
units.deliverable: `/predict`, `/healthz`, `/readyz` with pydantic schemas and documented error model.

units.title: FastAPI II: API tests, integration tests and model lifecycle
units.objective: Test the service at the HTTP boundary (happy path, invalid input, model missing), manage model loading at startup, reason about concurrency.
units.deliverable: API and integration test suite running without a network.

units.title: Project milestone 2: packaged inference + API
units.objective: Integrate artifact, inference pipeline and API in the project with tests and usage documentation.
units.deliverable: Tagged project release candidate; submit for review.

units.title: Review and catch-up (light)
units.objective: Retrieve, do not re-read: answer the week's retrieval questions from memory, redo one failed check or challenge unassisted, complete the mixed interview set, update progress flags.
units.deliverable: Week 5 retrieval sheet; ML system design rep 1 (45 min, rubric after).

units.title: Docker I: images, layers and a correct Dockerfile
units.objective: Explain what an image and container are; write a Dockerfile for the API (non-root, .dockerignore, cache-friendly layer order) and run it locally.
units.deliverable: Local container serving predictions; image build is repeatable.
units.prerequisites: w5d6; Docker Engine installed on Pop!_OS.

units.title: Docker II: pinned dependencies, multi-stage builds, smoke tests
units.objective: Make the environment reproducible (lockfile, pinned base image digest), reduce image size, and smoke-test the container.
units.deliverable: Multi-stage image with lockfile and an automated container smoke test.

units.title: Continuous integration with GitHub Actions
units.objective: Automate lint, tests and image build on every push; decide what belongs in CI versus scheduled evaluation jobs.
units.deliverable: Green CI workflow on the project repository with caching.

units.title: Latency, throughput and resource use
units.objective: Measure p50/p95/p99 latency and memory under load, find the bottleneck, and tune workers/batching against a stated budget.
units.deliverable: Load-test report with method, percentiles and one evidence-based optimisation.

units.title: One small cloud deployment on AWS (authorisation-gated)
units.objective: Understand IAM, credentials, registries and cost; deploy the container by one route, or complete the fully local equivalent if cloud use is not authorised.
units.deliverable: Deployment runbook; either a deployed endpoint (with explicit authorisation and teardown) or a local dry-run with the same configuration.
units.prerequisites: w6d2; AWS account decisions made by you; cost briefing read.

units.title: Delivery and operational debugging; project milestone 3
units.objective: Promote an image by tag, configure through environment, read logs to diagnose seeded failures, and roll back.
units.deliverable: Debugging log for three seeded failures + rollback demonstration.

units.title: Review and catch-up (light)
units.objective: Retrieve, do not re-read: answer the week's retrieval questions from memory, redo one failed check or challenge unassisted, complete the mixed interview set, update progress flags.
units.deliverable: Week 6 retrieval sheet; interview set 6 (debugging narrative + Python, timed).

units.title: Structured logging and service metrics
units.objective: Emit structured request and prediction logs with correlation ids; define the service's golden signals (traffic, errors, latency, saturation).
units.deliverable: Structured logs + metrics endpoint; a query that answers 'what happened to request X'.

units.title: Input monitoring and drift statistics
units.objective: Detect schema violations, range and missingness changes and distribution shift (PSI, KS, Wasserstein) with windows and thresholds chosen for an acceptable false-alarm rate.
units.deliverable: Drift monitor with a measured false-alarm rate on stable data.

units.title: Drift is not degradation: delayed labels and measured performance
units.objective: Separate input change from measured performance loss; design label backfill, proxy metrics and delayed evaluation.
units.deliverable: Replay experiment showing drift without degradation and degradation without flagged drift.

units.title: Model updates: retraining triggers, shadow and canary, rollback
units.objective: Define when and how a model is replaced: triggers, offline gate, shadow/canary comparison, versioned rollback.
units.deliverable: Update and rollback procedure exercised locally with two model versions.

units.title: Reliability and failure handling
units.objective: Handle bad input, timeouts, missing models and dependency failures deliberately: guards, fallbacks, degradation, failure-injection drills.
units.deliverable: Failure-injection test suite and a short incident note.

units.title: Project milestone 4: monitoring demonstration and runbook
units.objective: Demonstrate monitoring on a replay of held-out experiments and document operating procedures.
units.deliverable: Monitoring demo + runbook; submit for review.

units.title: Review and catch-up (light)
units.objective: Retrieve, do not re-read: answer the week's retrieval questions from memory, redo one failed check or challenge unassisted, complete the mixed interview set, update progress flags.
units.deliverable: Week 7 retrieval sheet; ML system design rep 2 (45 min, spoken).

units.title: Project completion audit: reproduce from a clean clone
units.objective: Audit the project against the deliverables checklist and reproduce every headline number from a fresh clone.
units.deliverable: Clean-clone reproduction log; gap list closed or explicitly scoped out.

units.title: Technical report and model limitations
units.objective: Write a short technical report and a limitations section that a sceptical reviewer would accept.
units.deliverable: 4-page report, model card, limitations.

units.title: ML system design
units.objective: Apply a repeatable structure (requirements, data, labels, evaluation, serving, monitoring, iteration) to two timed designs, one in an unfamiliar domain.
units.deliverable: Two written designs scored against the rubric.

units.title: Coding and SQL interviews, timed
units.objective: Solve Python data-structure and SQL problems under time pressure while explaining aloud.
units.deliverable: Timed set results and an error log by pattern.

units.title: Explaining the project and defending tradeoffs
units.objective: Deliver 5-minute and 20-minute walkthroughs and answer adversarial questions on evaluation, limitations and alternatives.
units.deliverable: Recorded walkthrough + written answers to ten hard questions.

units.title: Final independent assessment
units.objective: Complete a parallel form of the diagnostic and the final transfer task unassisted, for comparison with Week 1 evidence.
units.deliverable: Final assessment submission.

units.title: Retrospective and evidence portfolio (light)
units.objective: Compare Week 1 and Week 8 evidence, list what is demonstrated versus still unassessed, plan the next eight weeks.
units.deliverable: Evidence portfolio index and personal next-steps plan.
